author: bardic-inspiration
name: Remake the World
summary: Reshapes the surrounding terrain to your will.

m.text: a handful of clay worth 1000+ GP

stats.effect: You reshape terrain in a 500-foot-radius area, raising hills, moving water, and creating walls up to 100 feet high. Structures in the area collapse or shift as you choose, and creatures inside make a Dexterity saving throw to avoid falling.
